column1: # Independent P4-F05 analytic golden, not CPU/GPU implementation output.
# contribution, ray-depth expected value, strict half-T median crossing in ln(T).
# Python math only evaluates closed-form expected constants; no renderer invoked.
# All single-pixel cases put projected mean at (.5,.5), unless off_axis camera cx=0
# with world mean (1,0,-2), still projected (.5,.5), axial 2 and ray sqrt(5).
# red_green: alpha .5 each, z2 DC(2,-2,-2) then z4 DC(-2,2,-2), same bg.
# same_depth: same colors/alpha, both z2, black bg, preserve input order.
# single_three_quarter: alpha .75,z4,DC0,black; virtual median previous z=0,T=1.
# median_before_earlyout: same but early_out=.5. First source terminates without
# contribution, T remains1/alpha0/expected0, but median was already set to2.
# black bg; second nextT=1e-6<=1e-4 is excluded, old T=.001 preserved.
# quarter_equality: red_green without bg, early_out=.25; terminal green excluded.
# but vis>0; C++ depth_acc/max(1-T,1e-10)=2e-20, not a weight==0 clear shortcut.
